relevance_note: Case series of three adult patients with GAMT deficiency with individual GAMT variants, plus a literature table (Table 1) of 12 previously published early-treated patients: "Here, we present the clinical outcomes of 3 adult patients with GAMT deficiency".
method_note: Patients 1-3 extracted from the case presentations by reading. Table 1 has patients as columns (header row 'Patient'); data column 1 is 'Pt 1 (current cohort)' = Patient 1, columns 2-13 are previously published patients labelled 'Table 1 column <k>' with the header cell (reference numbers and patient numbers, e.g. '(14) pt. 1') copied into source_reference_in_review. A short Python script split Table 1 rows into cells (multi-line Genotype, Arginine restriction and Creatine post-tx rows handled) and built row-label-through-cell spans; cell contents were checked against the table by eye. Columns 10 and 11 are marked ^a 'Siblings' in the table notes (no family label given; they are siblings of each other). Column 2 genotype 'c.442dupC (p.Gln148Profs*43) AND null allele per RNA studies': the second allele has no printed variant, kept as a 'not reported' row. Column 6 genotype is 'Unknown': no variant row. Sex '—' (columns 3-4) recorded as not reported. Zygosity recorded only where the cell says 'Homozygous'; two-variant genotypes ('X AND Y') left not reported (no 'compound heterozygous' stated). Variant type not stated for any variant. Pathogenicity 'pathogenic' for Patients 1-3 from their own sentences; not reported for literature patients. Laboratory values (creatine/GAA pre/post treatment) were not turned into features except Patient 1's text 'elevated plasma GAA and low creatine'. Table 1 'Symptoms before therapy: None' recorded as feature 'symptoms before therapy' excluded and 'Outcomes: Normal' as 'abnormal outcome' excluded; per D-27 these whole-assessment statements exclude no specific checklist item. Column 13 'Normal development at 14 and 31 months' vs 'Borderline DD at 8 years': time-dependent, only the later observed DD recorded. 'DD-speech' (columns 5) and '2 word sentences' (column 10) not mapped to 'absent or limited speech'; Patient 1 ADHD not mapped to 'hyperactivity'; Patient 2 'wide-based gait' and column 2 'dysdiadochokinesis' not mapped to 'ataxia'. Patient 1 'Normal intellectual ability'/'average ... intellectual ability' recorded as intellectual disability excluded (D-27) while the checklist item 'developmental delay or intellectual disability' is observed from his early developmental delay. The Discussion's 'recently reported GAMT-deficiency patient ... [19]' is most likely the Table 1 column 2 patient (header '(19)'); no separate row was created. is_proband left null (case series, no proband/index wording). Vital status 'alive' for Patients 1-3 from present-tense current descriptions. Inconsistency: Patient 2 is said to be diagnosed at 12.5 years old but to have started treatment 'at 12 years old'. Table 1 column 2 started therapy at 15 months although the Discussion describes Table 1 as treated < 15 months.
